sources.name: Original NHD page export (student's own page)
sources.author: Ronuk Gadamsetty / project team
sources.used_for: Nav tag, title, subtitle, intro paragraph, 13 text, Thesis link, original id selectors and base rules
changes: Nav tag, title, subtitle, intro paragraph, the 13 text, and the Thesis link reused as written
Title and subtitle given Bootstrap classes; "13 Children died. America changed forever." split into three lines so the 13 can count up
Original rules kept: body and .auto-nav colors; #ihq6k rule reduced to padding, text-align and font-size (values changed)

sources.name: Bootstrap 4.3.1 compiled CSS
sources.author: The Bootstrap Authors, Twitter Inc.
sources.used_for: Rules copied to restyle Bootstrap parts to DESIGN.md; NHD full-width override
changes: Rules copied from bootstrap.css with selectors prefixed with #fm and values changed to DESIGN.md colors, sizes, radius 0 and hard print shadows
.container rule and its four @media max-width rules applied to NHD's wrapper .container.it-is-set with max-width 100% and no side padding, so the page fills the screen
body rule applied to #fm with Georgia, 19px, line height 1.7 and the ink and paper colors
.bg-light copied twice and renamed .bg-aged and .bg-mist for the two extra paper colors; .py-5 copied as .py-6 with 5rem
.blockquote-footer::before content emptied (removes the default dash)
Carousel arrow icon SVGs recolored from white to ink
z-index (from the .carousel-control rule) used on .rv so the dashed outline stays visible
prefers-reduced-motion rule for .carousel-item applied to everything in #fm with transition none
